'''2014 MPC Holotable Chris Terwilliger LS It Is The Future You See (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Holotable).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|VB2-L-itisthefutureyousee-pre.gif|label=It Is The Future You See (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Holotable
